title: Synthetic Canonical Stage Journey
core_invariant: Start with the useful whole. Predict before running. Transfer without assistance. Prove competence with evidence.

stages.title: Frame the generic journey
stages.instructions: Read the mission invariant, canonical stage catalogue, and assistance policies. Identify the evidence the gate will require. This document is a generic composition of catalogue stages, not a named-mission special case.

stages.title: Predict, execute, and submit a numeric transform
stages.instructions: Complete the experiment cycle on a generic numeric series. (1) PREDICT the result of applying scale=2 to [1, 2, 3, 4]. (2) COMMIT the prediction so it cannot be edited. (3) EXECUTE the transform. (4) OBSERVE the structured metric result. (5) SUBMIT an explanation of any delta between prediction and observation.

validation_rubric.pass_criteria: Prediction is sealed before execute; the submitted explanation covers the observed series and the scale factor.

stages.title: Fresh-case transform without assistance
stages.instructions: Apply the same scale-transform protocol to a fresh series and scale factor supplied at runtime. Tutor, hints, and prior-answer surfaces stay locked.

validation_rubric.pass_criteria: Produces the correctly scaled series for the unseen inputs.

stages.title: Evaluate gate evidence
stages.instructions: Evaluate submitted orientation, experiment, and transfer evidence against the mission gate contract. Issue PASSED or a targeted repair plan.
